description.en: Electric 50 vs Diesel 50 Concrete Pump. 55 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Voltage.

h1.en: Electric 50 vs Diesel 50 Concrete Pump: 55 kW beside the Voltage article
h1.zh: 电动50和柴油50混凝土泵有何不同：对照「電壓」时，55 kW仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Electric 50 and Diesel 50 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 50 lists a 55 kW motor, 26 m³/h and three stone-distance rows. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage.
directAnswer.zh: 电动50和柴油50是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。电动50标出 55 kW 电机、26 m³/h 和三行石子距离。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage. The picture shows Voltage. Electric 50 and Diesel 50 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Theoretical output: Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h. Diesel 50 lists 30 m³/h. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage。画面是Voltage。电动50和柴油50是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。重量并不相同：电动50为 2800 kg，柴油50为 3300 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大出口压力两边都是 30 MPa；料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³；液压泵两边都是 Kawasaki 140。对照相同的 30 MPa 之前，先读动力行。

body.en: Electric 50 lists a 55 kW motor, 26 m³/h and three stone-distance rows. Dimensions: Electric 50 lists 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Diesel 50 lists 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Read the drive line before comparing the shared 30 MPa entry. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 电动50标出 55 kW 电机、26 m³/h 和三行石子距离。理论输送量：电动50标出 26 m³/h；柴油50标出 30 m³/h。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看电动50请打开 /zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/，看柴油50请打开 /zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Diesel 50 lists engine 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h and one distance pair, 150 m / 450 m. Main unit weight: Electric 50 lists 2800 kg. Diesel 50 lists 3300 kg. Electric 50 lists entries that Diesel 50 does not: Motor power 55 kW. Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m. 13 mm stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m. 24 mm stone (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. Open /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ for Electric 50 and /en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 50.
body.zh: 柴油50标出发动机 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h 和一组距离 150 m / 450 m。外形尺寸：电动50标出 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm；柴油50标出 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。电动50有、柴油50没有的行：电机功率 55 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Both list 30 MPa, Kawasaki 140, a 0.4 m³ hopper and 3300 kg is not shared: Electric 50 lists 2800 kg and Diesel 50 lists 3300 kg. The same shown value on a shared label: Max. outlet pressure is 30 MPa on both pages. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. Hydraulic pump is Kawasaki 140 on both pages. Diesel 50 lists entries that Electric 50 does not: Diesel engine power 6105 / 99 kW. Pumping distance (H / V) 150 m / 450 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 两边都标出 30 MPa、川崎140 和料斗 0.4 m³。整机重量：电动50标出 2800 kg；柴油50标出 3300 kg。柴油50有、电动50没有的行：柴油机功率 6105 / 99 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 450 m。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 50 list the same theoretical output as Diesel 50?
question.zh: 电动50和柴油50的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h. Diesel 50 lists 30 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50标出 26 m³/h。柴油50标出 30 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 50 list the same dimensions as Diesel 50?
question.zh: 电动50和柴油50的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 lists 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Diesel 50 lists 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50标出 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。柴油50标出 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. Electric 50 lists 2800 kg. Diesel 50 lists 3300 kg. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50标出 2800 kg。柴油50标出 3300 kg。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is motor power missing on Diesel 50?
question.zh: 为什么柴油50没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Diesel 50 page does not list that label. Electric 50 lists 55 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage.
answer.zh: 柴油50这一页没有标出这个标题。电动50标出的是 55 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voltage画面里印出的数字。
